evals.prompt: Spec this feature: let users export the generated files as a zip. (The repository has no .specify/ folder and specify is not installed.)
evals.expected_output: Phase detection reports setup as the phase, the pinned install and specify init commands are shown, and nothing is installed or initialized before the user approves.
expectations: States the detected phase is setup because .specify/ is missing, before any other action
Loads references/setup.md and checks uv --version and specify version
Shows uv tool install specify-cli --from git+https://github.com/github/spec-kit.git@v1.2.1
Shows specify init --here --integration claude with --no-model-invocation and does not pass --force
Asks for approval before installing or running specify init; does not run /speckit-specify yet

evals.prompt: Write a spec for a dark-mode toggle. (.specify/ exists; .specify/memory/constitution.md still contains [PROJECT_NAME] and [PRINCIPLE_1_NAME].)
evals.expected_output: The constitution is detected as unfilled, the constitution phase runs first with a chosen profile, and no spec is written until the constitution is approved.
expectations: States the detected phase is constitution because the template placeholders are still present
Asks which profile to use (power-platform, typescript-web, both or none) before running /speckit-constitution
Runs /speckit-constitution, not /speckit-specify
Stops for approval of .specify/memory/constitution.md and says the spec comes next

evals.prompt: Just build it. (specs/003-zip-export/ has spec.md and plan.md approved, but no tasks.md.)
evals.expected_output: Code is refused because tasks aren't approved; the reply names the tasks phase as the one waiting and offers to run it.
expectations: Does not create or edit any source file
States the detected phase is tasks because plan.md exists without tasks.md
Explains that implementation waits for approved tasks
Offers to run /speckit-tasks and stop for review

evals.prompt: Spec this: users should be able to share projects with their team. (Constitution approved; no feature folder yet.)
evals.expected_output: The spec is created with clarification markers for the undefined parts (who the team is, permissions, sharing mechanism) or questions are asked; nothing is guessed.
expectations: Runs /speckit-specify with the user's description without adding technology choices
Leaves [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: ...] markers or asks questions for team membership and permissions instead of inventing them
Offers or runs /speckit-clarify for the open markers
Stops for approval of spec.md before any plan

evals.prompt: Implement the next task. (tasks.md is approved; T003 'add zip builder' is the first open task; the plan names npm test.)
evals.expected_output: Only T003 is implemented, the tests run and pass, T003 is ticked, and a commit through aidevme-github is offered but not run.
expectations: Says T003 is the task being implemented and scopes /speckit-implement to it
Runs npm test after the change and reports the result
Ticks T003 (- [x] T003) only because the tests pass
Proposes a commit message that names T003 and hands it to aidevme-github
Does not run git commit, git push or create a branch

evals.prompt: Do the whole thing for a CSV import feature. (Constitution approved; no feature folder yet.)
evals.expected_output: The phases are chained from specify onward, but the skill stops after the spec for approval instead of continuing straight to plan, tasks and code.
expectations: States the phases it will chain: specify, plan, tasks, implement, converge
Runs /speckit-specify and then stops at the spec review gate
Does not run /speckit-plan, /speckit-tasks or /speckit-implement in the same turn without approval
Says which gate is waiting and what the user should review

evals.prompt: All tasks are done, open the PR. (Every task in tasks.md is ticked; the diff also adds a 'Download log' button that no requirement in spec.md mentions.)
evals.expected_output: Converge runs before any pull request handoff, the extra button is reported as drift, and the user is asked whether to update the spec or remove the code.
expectations: States the detected phase is converge because all tasks are ticked
Runs /speckit-converge (or compares git diff against spec.md and tasks.md if it isn't available)
Reports the Download log button as behavior the spec doesn't cover
Asks whether to update spec.md or fix the code, and does not hand off the pull request yet

evals.prompt: Plan the feature: a PCF control that shows a record's approval status as a badge. (Constitution uses the power-platform profile with publisher prefix cnt; spec.md approved.)
evals.expected_output: The plan is checked against the power-platform profile: it names the ControlManifest.Input.xml and index.ts change together, documents the new property, and names the solution the control is packaged in.
expectations: Runs /speckit-plan with the technical context and loads references/profiles/power-platform.md
Checks that the plan changes ControlManifest.Input.xml and index.ts in the same task and documents the new property
Checks that the plan names the cnt-prefixed solution and managed deployment downstream
Checks that no environment URL, ID or secret is hard-coded
Stops for approval of plan.md

evals.prompt: Set up spec kit. (.specify/ already exists with a filled constitution, and specs/002-search/ has spec.md and plan.md but no tasks.md.)
evals.expected_output: Spec Kit is not initialized again; the skill reports the existing setup and continues from the detected phase, tasks for 002-search.
expectations: Does not run specify init and does not use --force
Reports that .specify/ already exists
States the detected phase is tasks for specs/002-search
Offers to run /speckit-tasks and stops for review
